answer: An agent economy resists sybils by anchoring each identity to a bonded write-ahead log whose append requires a unique proof-of-work nonce, so a fake raven cannot fork history without detectable divergence. Colluding identities must sustain a cache-consistency invariant across shards, and any ripple in the committed epoch ordering exposes the fable of distinct participants. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
